title: systemc-signoff-evidence: review reports, measurement scripts and data for Proof Before Push
description: Independent review reports, measurement scripts and data behind the report Proof Before Push, which applies a sign-off checklist (fail-then-pass test, baseline regression, clean build, independent review) to 58 change branches in four open SystemC verification libraries: SystemC, UVM-SystemC, CRAVE and FC4SC. Includes a manifest pinning each measured branch to its commit and instructions to reproduce Table 1. This release also contains SCBench: 15 maintenance tasks graded by hidden regression tests, the scbench-mcp verification tool server, the harness, and scrubbed results of a pilot with coding agents, with models labelled Model A, B and C. Version 1.2.0 isolates each agent workspace from the repository history (a first harness version let one model reach the reference changes; the audit and the affected runs are included), and reports that model's rerun.
